top_paper.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
top_paper.summary: SWE-Trail improves trajectory collection for coding agents by using past rollouts to guide exploration without exposing history to the agent, yielding better-trained student models.

papers.title: "Shall We Approve?" Consequence-Aware Approval for Autonomous Coding Agents
papers.summary: Caper pre-executes shell commands in isolated sandboxes to evaluate real-world effects before approval, reducing harmful outcomes compared to text-based approvers.

papers.title: What We Keep of What We Forget: Replacement Operators and Routing Semantics in Training-Free MoE Expert Pruning
papers.summary: Comparing replacement operators for pruned mixture-of-experts experts reveals that gate scaling and calibration domain strongly affect performance, with a proposed tilted novice operator improving results without dominating all settings.

papers.title: Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
papers.summary: Cross-pathway concept unlearning in unified multimodal models is addressed by a new benchmark and method that jointly suppresses target concept generation and recognition while preserving other capabilities.

papers.title: Can AI Reviewers See Your Efforts to Improve Your Paper? A Large-Scale Study of Paper Revision Trajectories
papers.summary: AI reviewers often fail to reflect manuscript improvements in scores, with user opinions frequently overriding observed revision gains.

papers.title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
papers.summary: Frontier vision-language models vary widely in embodied task performance, with closed-weight systems leading in planning and manipulation while open-weight models lag, and failure patterns reveal distinct geometric, control, and reasoning errors rather than uniform deficits.

papers.title: Enhancing Stock Market Information Retrieval with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.summary: A retrieval-augmented generation system for stock market queries improves response accuracy and speed, validated by high ROUGE scores and low latency.

papers.title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
papers.summary: Kling's multimodal understanding stack links caption density, perceptual text encoding, reward modeling, and evaluation protocols to improve controllable video generation.

papers.title: Near-Zero Token Embeddings Silently Stall Training in Gated Sequence Models
papers.summary: Near-zero input embeddings in untied gated language models cause extreme gradient amplification and training instability, which is addressed by GroupClip and GateFloor remedies.

papers.title: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
papers.summary: LOLPlay evaluates visual agents on real-time League of Legends tasks, finding that increased reasoning effort does not improve success and can reduce interaction time.

papers.title: Where to Learn and How Far to Roll Out: Efficient Adaptive Training for GUI Agents
papers.summary: A two-stage adaptive framework improves multi-step GUI agent training by using intermediate checkpoints and selective rollout ranges to reduce environment interactions while boosting performance.

papers.title: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
papers.summary: PrimeSim is an action-conditioned multiview world model that uses progressive training, unified action representations, view-aware attention, and hierarchical memory to enable consistent, long-horizon robot simulation and policy optimization.

papers.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
papers.summary: Mage-VL-Cowork is a 4B hybrid computer-use agent trained via a progressive curriculum and scalable synthetic data generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on OSWorld-Verified with efficient reasoning.

papers.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
papers.summary: Recursa is a self-improving foundation model system that adapts to new domains by recursively learning from its own experience, storing skills and reflections in a knowledge repository, and validating improvements without human supervision or stronger teachers.

papers.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: SpecPilot autonomously discovers deployment-specific algorithms and system optimizations to maximize speculative decoding speedups across diverse models, drafters, and serving regimes without quality loss.

papers.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
papers.summary: ParetoSaddler improves LLM agent harnesses by separately promoting intermediate candidates via Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support and selecting final deployments, boosting quality while reducing cost.

papers.title: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
papers.summary: MoviEdit is an end-to-end framework for long-form multi-shot video editing that uses cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive modeling and a new benchmark to maintain coherence across scenes while reducing manual data annotation.

papers.title: SeMo3D: Unifying 3D Generation, Editing, and Completion via Selective Modeling
papers.summary: SeMo3D unifies 3D generation, editing, and completion through selective region modeling, using region-selective denoising and a multi-condition diffusion transformer to preserve unchanged content and enable training without paired data.

papers.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
papers.summary: RoboColosseum evaluates general robot policies across diverse embodiments and environments, revealing weak cross-embodiment agreement, limited open-world reliability, and substantial differences between zero-shot and fine-tuned performance.

papers.title: StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games
papers.summary: StreamDuo pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that retrieves game wiki entries to improve cross-game streaming commentary without training on target games.

papers.title: A Tutorial on Generative Models for Music Audio
papers.summary: This monograph surveys neural methods for music audio generation, covering codecs, autoregressive and diffusion models, flow matching, preference optimization, evaluation practices, and legal considerations.

papers.title: History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models
papers.summary: History Forcing improves long-range consistency in few-step autoregressive video generation by using historical context residuals to correct distillation targets.

papers.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
papers.summary: IdeaTaste benchmarks LLM research proposals against future publications, revealing that AI agents match human communities in broad directions but fall far behind in concrete approaches and expected success.

papers.title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Order-only on-policy distillation trains students to match teacher token rankings rather than probabilities, improving reasoning performance without temperature tuning.

papers.title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
papers.summary: Layer-wise error modeling and token-wise Fisher statistics improve low-rank SVD compression of large language models by refining rank allocation and decomposition quality.

papers.title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
papers.summary: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization improves long-context retrieval in gated linear recurrent models by jointly configuring decay and sensitivity parameters before training.

papers.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: DR Pixel is an open-source multimodal agent that performs deep research directly on rendered document page images, improving retrieval and reasoning over scientific papers through counterfactual credit reweighting.

papers.title: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev
papers.summary: Jev's cross-primitive consistency is benchmarked and improved via a residual calibrator that reduces inconsistency and boosts decision accuracy.

papers.title: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
papers.summary: MACR introduces a relay-based multi-agent framework that dynamically transfers reasoning between agents using confidence-guided triggering and bidding to improve accuracy with lower token overhead.

papers.title: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
papers.summary: Vision-language models often judge 3D object properties correctly but fail to recover and consistently apply exact per-color counts, motivating evaluation by exact correctness, consistency, and visual dependence.
